recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not re-add an XDS mapping to DocumentReference.date for FHIR-12892 unless a new work-group decision reverses FHIR-19685/FHIR-43408.
issue_request: FHIR-12892 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2 and requested that the old DocumentReference.created element have no XDS mapping, the old indexed element map to DocumentEntry.creationTime, and status map to DocumentEntry.availabilityStatus.
initial_application: Commit 94e532a611046fcdc40df2d7d28457eeb7dad3a6 applied the San Diego WGM block vote including FHIR-12892, removing the XDS map from DocumentReference.created, mapping the then-renamed indexing field DocumentReference.date to DocumentEntry.creationTime, and mapping status to DocumentEntry.availabilityStatus.
additional_context: FHIR-19685 later published the rule that DocumentEntry.creationTime should map to DocumentReference.content.attachment.creation and that DocumentReference.date has no XDS mapping. FHIR-43408 later applied the R6 XDS/MHD alignment with date blank and content.attachment carrying creationTime plus repositoryUniqueId/URI. DocumentReference is active in source/fhir.ini.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current source maps DocumentReference.status to DocumentEntry.availabilityStatus, leaves DocumentReference.date without an XDS mapping, and maps DocumentReference.content.attachment to DocumentEntry.creationTime, matching the seed as superseded by later decisions.
